quickDetails.heading: Quick details
quickDetails.sub: Everything at a glance before you read the day-by-day plan.

whereYouStay.heading: Where you stay
whereYouStay.hotelNote: Hotels are the properties we book most often on this route. If one is unavailable for your dates we substitute the same or a higher category and confirm it in writing.

itineraryGlance.heading: Itinerary at a glance
itineraryGlance.sub: The whole trip on one page — days, plan, where you sleep and which meals are covered.

pricing.heading: What you pay
pricing.sub: Per person on twin-sharing basis, land package. Return flights price constantly — add one on request at the fare live on your travel date, or use the estimate in Optional add-ons below.
pricing.scaledNoteTemplate: Scaled from the base {baseNights}N / {baseDays}D itinerary at {perNightRate} per person per night. The day-by-day plan below follows the original {baseNights}N / {baseDays}D route — a planner adjusts it for the extra nights before confirming.

backCover.paragraph: Send us your dates and we will turn this into a confirmed, priced itinerary — usually the same day.
